summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container. Changes: Update(prologue, algebra) class in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py returns Update(prologue, res) for non-empty requests; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate in processor.py (records _original_args like prepareQuery); prepareUpdate exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepared_update.py. Deviation from spec: the empty-request case returns Update(None, []) instead of a bare [], because a bare list would break evalUpdate and the empty-string path. Nothing was run, per instructions, and nothing was committed, so the new tests and existing prepareQuery/DAWG tests are unverified.
